relations.subject: Francis Buchanan
relations.evidence: Buchanan studied medicine at the University of Edinburgh, graduating MD in 1783.

relations.subject: Francis Buchanan
relations.evidence: He also studied botany under John Hope in Edinburgh.

relations.subject: John Hope
relations.evidence: Hope was among the first to teach the Linnean system of botanical nomenclature, although he knew of several others having been trained under Antoine Laurent de Jussieu.

relations.subject: Francis Buchanan
relations.evidence: served in the Bengal Medical Service from 1794 to 1815.

relations.subject: Francis Buchanan
relations.object: Institution for Promoting the Natural History of India
relations.evidence: In 1804, he was in charge of the Institution for Promoting the Natural History of India founded by Wellesley at Barrackpore.

relations.subject: Francis Buchanan
relations.evidence: He succeeded William Roxburgh to become the superintendent of the Calcutta botanical garden in 1814

relations.subject: Francis Buchanan
relations.evidence: From 1814 until 1829 he was the official Keeper of the Royal Botanic Garden, Edinburgh, succeeding William Roxburgh.
